common.storageUnavailable: This browser can't save data. Your entries may be lost when you close the window.
common.offline: Running without a server. Product DB, routines, vanity, masks and photo recognition work; user-entry search, requests and admin need the server.

scope.notice: Covers basic skincare (cleanser to cream) and sunscreen. Makeup products are not supported.
scope.makeupDetected: This looks like a makeup product. SkinStack doesn't analyze routines or combinations for makeup.

dataSource.demoInfo: Sample product. Only the name is known — ingredients and directions are unverified.
dataSource.ocrInfo: Text extracted from label photos. It may contain recognition errors — compare with the label.
dataSource.communityInfo: Entered by other users from their labels. Not yet reviewed by an admin, so it may contain errors.
dataSource.catalogInfo: From product data reviewed and approved by an admin. It may differ from your label depending on country or formula version.

home.title: Today
home.emptyText: Add the skincare products you own and we'll build morning and evening routines from them.
home.verifyTitle: Verify product info to build a routine
home.verifyText: A product name alone doesn't tell us its ingredients or directions, so no routine has been built yet. Please confirm each product's type and label details.
home.verifyInfo: Choose the product type and tick 'I checked this against the label' to include it. Adding the ingredient list and directions lets us flag combinations more accurately.
home.someExcluded: {n} product(s) need checking and were left out of the routine
home.disclaimer: SkinStack does not provide medical advice. Follow product labels and instructions first, and if your skin reacts, stop using the product and consult a professional.

why.category: Placed as a {category} step, following texture-based order.
why.labelTime: Matches the time of use you entered (from the label).
why.activePm: An ingredient that may irritate was found (or inferred), so it's placed in the evening. Change the time of use if the label says otherwise.
why.scheduled: Spread across the week to match your frequency ({n}× a week).
why.useFirst: Best to use first among {others} other product(s) of this type ({reason}).
why.rotation: Rotates by day with {n} other product(s) of the same type.
why.suggested: The app set this to start at {n}× a week based on {groups} in the ingredient list. You can change it.
why.suggestedPlain: The app set this to start at {n}× a week. You can change it.

tip.label: Label directions: {text}
tip.noUsage: No directions on file. Follow the directions printed on the product.
tip.sensitiveActive: You marked your skin as sensitive. Consider trying it on a small area first.

cat.cleanser: Gently pat skin dry after cleansing.
cat.wash_off_mask: Leave on only for the time shown on the package, then rinse.
cat.toner: Use as the first step after cleansing.
cat.sheet_mask: Remove within the stated time and pat in the remaining essence.
cat.essence: Spread thinly and let it absorb before the next step.
cat.serum: Let it absorb before the next step.
cat.ampoule: Let it absorb before the next step.
cat.eye: Tap a small amount around the eyes.
cat.balm: Use a small amount on dry areas.
cat.oil: Use a small amount as the last moisturizing step.
cat.sunscreen: Last step of the morning routine. Follow the amount and reapplication directions on the label.

warn.noIngredients: No ingredient list · combinations not assessed

exclude.unverified: Not yet checked against the label.
exclude.drug: Classified as a drug, so it's left out of suggested routines. Follow your doctor's or pharmacist's instructions and the leaflet.
exclude.regulatory_check: Check the label to confirm whether this is a drug, quasi-drug or cosmetic.
exclude.expired: Past its use-by date. Check before using.
exclude.pregnancy_consult: You indicated pregnancy or breastfeeding. Products with this ingredient are left out so you can talk to a doctor or pharmacist first.
exclude.frequency_unknown: Contains an ingredient that may irritate, so a usage frequency is needed. Enter the frequency recommended on the label or leaflet.

retinoid_exfoliant.title: Retinoid + AHA/BHA
retinoid_exfoliant.why: Using these at the same time is known to increase the chance of irritation.
retinoid_exfoliant.guide: Consider using them on different days or at different times, and check each product's directions.

retinoid_bpo.title: Retinoid + benzoyl peroxide
retinoid_bpo.why: Together they may irritate, and some retinoids can become less stable.
retinoid_bpo.guide: Check the product leaflets and professional guidance.

vitc_exfoliant.title: Vitamin C + AHA/BHA
vitc_exfoliant.why: Depending on your skin, this may sting.
vitc_exfoliant.guide: If it stings, try separating them by time of day. Check product directions.

multi_retinoid.title: More than one retinoid product
multi_retinoid.why: Layering similar ingredients may increase irritation.
multi_retinoid.guide: Consider using only one at a time.

multi_exfoliant.title: More than one exfoliating product
multi_exfoliant.why: Layering AHA, BHA and PHA may over-exfoliate.

verified_note.title: Combination note with a reviewed source
verified_note.why: The reviewed product data includes guidance about this combination.
verified_note.guide: See the evidence and source below.

high_percent_sensitive.title: High-percentage product
high_percent_sensitive.why: The name states a high concentration and you marked your skin as sensitive.
high_percent_sensitive.guide: Consider starting at a lower frequency and check the product's directions.

no_sunscreen.title: No morning sunscreen
no_sunscreen.why: You use retinoids or exfoliants in the evening but have no sunscreen in the morning. Many products advise daytime sun protection.
no_sunscreen.guide: Check the guidance on the product labels.

no_data.title: Products without ingredient data
no_data.why: Without an ingredient list we can't assess combinations. That does not mean they are safe together.
no_data.guide: Add the ingredient list from a photo of the back label.

active_plus_barrier.title: Active ingredient + moisturizing ingredient
active_plus_barrier.why: You could consider pairing it with a product that contains moisturizing ingredients. Results are not guaranteed.

pm_active_am_sunscreen.title: Evening actives + morning sunscreen
pm_active_am_sunscreen.why: On days you use actives in the evening, you could consider sunscreen the next morning.

report.combosInfo: Ingredients found in an ingredient list are shown as 'May need caution'; ones inferred only from a product name are shown as 'Check product directions'. 'Do not combine' is shown only with a reviewed source.
report.noCombos: No flagged combinations. (Products without ingredient data were not assessed.)
report.evidenceNote: Evidence is the ingredient name found in the label info you entered. Actual concentration and formula may differ.
report.stopIfIrritation: If your skin becomes irritated, stop using the product and check its leaflet or ask a professional.
report.similarInfo: Products of the same type or with overlapping key ingredients. This is not a request to delete or stop using anything.
report.similarNote: Using up what you have before buying more is always an option.
report.needsCheck: Items that need evidence or product info

dup.title: You already own something similar
dup.lead: Your vanity has products similar to the one you're adding.
dup.leadWishlist: Your vanity already has products similar to this one. Using those up first is an option.
dup.note: This comparison is for reference only. It's your call.
dup.turnOff: Don't show this alert again (you can turn it back on in Settings)
dup.useFirst: I'll use what I have first

vault.shelfHint: Items with a ! sticker join your routine once you check their label info.
vault.title: Vanity
vault.emptyText: Add products by search, label photo or manual entry.

wishlist.title: Shopping list
wishlist.info: Note products you plan to buy and we'll point out similar ones you already own.
wishlist.lead: Check for overlap with what you own before buying.
wishlist.removeText: This item will be removed from your shopping list.

add.title: Add product
add.searchHint: Search covers admin-reviewed products and products entered by other users.
add.communityNotice: Entered by other users (not yet reviewed). Make sure it matches the label on your product before saving.
add.searchInfo: We don't have data for every cosmetic in the world. If a product isn't found, read the label from a photo or enter it manually, and send a product request.
add.noResultsText: You can add it from a label photo or enter it manually.
add.catalogNotice: Loaded reviewed product data. Check it matches the label on your product before saving.
add.photoLead: Take photos of the front (name) and back (ingredients, directions). Bright light and sharp text work best.
add.photoInfoAi: Photos are sent to the server, where AI transcribes the label text. Information that isn't visible in the photo is left blank.
add.photoInfoLocal: Free text recognition (OCR) runs on this device. The first run downloads recognition data and may take a while.
add.privacyAi: Photos are used only to extract text and are not stored on the server.
add.ocrNotice: This was extracted from photos. Recognition can be wrong — please compare with the label and correct it.
add.ocrUnreadable: Most of the text couldn't be read.
add.notFoundRequest: Can't find your product? Request it
add.demoNotice: This is a demo product. Its ingredients and directions are unverified — enter the type, ingredients and directions from the real label.

form.name: Product name
form.categoryInfo: Choose the product type shown on the label. Application order follows texture and the manufacturer's directions.
form.quantityInfo: If you own several of the same product, enter how many (including the one in use).
form.regulatoryInfo: Drugs are never added to suggested routines. Classification rules differ by country — look for markings such as 'Quasi-drug', 'Functional cosmetic' or 'Drug Facts' on the label.
form.pharmaFlag: Made by a pharmaceutical company. Check the label to confirm whether it is a drug, quasi-drug or cosmetic.
form.ingredientsInfo: Copy the full ingredient list exactly as printed, in order, separated by commas. Don't guess.
form.usageInfo: Enter the directions from the label or leaflet. They take priority when ordering steps and timing.
form.usagePlaceholder: e.g. After toner, apply an appropriate amount to the face.
form.timeOfUseInfo: On auto, the app decides from the ingredient list: retinol and AHA/BHA in the evening, UV filters in the morning, everything else morning and evening. Pick one if the label says otherwise.
form.frequencyInfo: On auto, the app decides from the ingredient list: retinol and exfoliants start at 2× a week, everything else daily. Pick one if the label recommends a frequency.
form.textureInfo: When several products share a step, thinner textures go first.
form.paoInfo: The number next to the open-jar symbol (e.g. 12M).
form.regionInfo: The same product can have a different ingredient list and regulation in each country.
form.verified: I checked this against the label / leaflet
form.verifiedInfo: Only verified products are used in routines. Anything you leave blank shows as 'Needs verification'.

product.title: Product
product.ingredientsInfo: Key ingredients are detected from the ingredient list you entered. Concentrations are unknown.
product.noIngredients: Without an ingredient list, combinations are not assessed.
product.detectedNote: 'From product name' means it was inferred only from the name and needs to be confirmed in the ingredient list.
product.deleteText: “{name}” and its order settings will be deleted. Usage history is kept.

masks.title: Sheet masks
masks.stockInfo: Add each brand's masks separately and pick which one to use on mask days. A mask with 0 sheets is removed from routines.
masks.weeksLeft: About {n} weeks at your current plan
masks.lessThanWeek: Less stock than this week's plan
masks.planInfo: Choose how many times a week and we'll space the days evenly. You can also tap days to change them.
masks.noUsable: No usable masks. Add stock or verify product info.
masks.noPlan: Tap days to plan your week
masks.tipText: Use masks on planned days rather than daily, and keep to the time on the package. Using them too often or too long may irritate.
masks.timerNote: The time on the package comes first
masks.emptyText: Add sheet masks with their count to plan your week and track stock.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.lead: You've finished {name}. How did your skin feel?
feedback.irritationNote: If it irritated your skin, stop using products with the same ingredients and see a professional if symptoms persist.

buy.searchNote: Check availability and price on the store.

disclosure.coupang: This link is part of the Coupang Partners program, and the operator receives a commission.
disclosure.amazon: As an Amazon Associate, the operator earns from qualifying purchases.

week.title: Weekly routine
week.lead: Morning and evening routines by day. Tap a date for details.
week.leadInfo: Products with an n×-a-week frequency are spread across days, and ingredients known to irritate together are placed on different days when possible.
week.scheduledInfo: Days assigned based on the frequency you entered.

requests.title: Product requests
requests.formInfo: An admin reviews each request against the label and manufacturer info. Approved products appear in search.
requests.lead: Brand and product name are required. A photo and ingredient link speed up review.
requests.name: Product name
requests.linkInfo: The manufacturer's page or any page showing the full ingredient list.
requests.notePlaceholder: Where you bought it, country, reformulation, etc.
requests.required: Please enter the brand and product name.
requests.none: You haven't sent any requests yet.

requestStatus.receivedDesc: Your request is waiting for review.
requestStatus.reviewingDesc: An admin is checking the product information.
requestStatus.needs_infoDesc: Please send the information needed for review.
requestStatus.approvedDesc: You can now find this product in search.
requestStatus.rejectedDesc: There wasn't enough verifiable information, or it's out of scope. You can still add it manually.

settings.title: Settings
settings.regionInfo: Region affects date formats, affiliate stores and regulatory notes.
settings.localeNote: Dates and times follow your device time zone ({tz}).
settings.profileLead: Your skin profile is optional and stored only on this device.
settings.notifyInfo: Reminders appear at the set time while the app (browser tab) is open. Push notifications when the app is closed aren't supported yet.
settings.notifyDenied: Notification permission was denied in the browser.
settings.dupAlertsInfo: Warns you about similar products when adding to your vanity or shopping list.
settings.shareInfo: Only brand, name, type, size, ingredients and directions of products you checked against the label are shared for search. Your skin profile and history are never shared.
settings.purchaseInfo: Purchase links appear only for products you said you'd buy again, always labelled as affiliate links.
settings.affNote: Affiliate codes are set by the operator as server environment variables. No purchase button is shown in regions without one.
settings.dataInfo: All products and history are stored in this browser. Export a backup before switching devices.
settings.resetText: Your vanity, history and settings will be deleted from this device. This can't be undone.

onboarding.welcome: Build a routine from what you own
onboarding.tagline: Rather than buying more, SkinStack helps you use the skincare you already have — safely and economically.
onboarding.f1: Add products by search, label photo or manual entry
onboarding.f2: Get morning, evening and day-by-day routines based on product info
onboarding.f3: See combinations to check and products that overlap
onboarding.profileLead: Everything works without it. If you fill it in, it's used for caution notes.
onboarding.privacy: Your skin profile is stored only on this device and never sent to the server.
onboarding.startTitle: How would you like to start?
onboarding.startLead: You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboarding.startAddDesc: Search, take a photo or enter manually.
onboarding.startDemoDesc: Loads 14 sample products, starting in an unverified state.

profile.sensitivityInfo: If you mark your skin as sensitive, you'll see extra notes for high-percentage products and potentially irritating ingredients.
profile.pregnancyInfo: Optional. If pregnant or breastfeeding, retinoid and hydroquinone products are left out of routines with a suggestion to consult a professional. Stored only on this device.

admin.title: Admin review
admin.disabled: Admin features are disabled. Set the ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variable on the server.
admin.loginNote: Permissions are checked on the server. Seeing this page does not grant access to any data without signing in.
admin.communityLead: Product info that users marked as checked against the label. It appears in search as unreviewed data; hide anything inappropriate.
admin.reviewLead: Enter only information confirmed from label photos or manufacturer pages. Leave unconfirmed ingredients blank.
admin.adminNoteInfo: Shown to the user with the status. When requesting more info, say what's needed.
admin.noteRequired: A note is required when requesting more info.
admin.sourceUrlInfo: Manufacturer page or store product page. Coupang/Amazon product URLs are used for repurchase links.
admin.interactionNotesInfo: Only with a source such as manufacturer directions. One per line: 'group | avoid or caution | source'. Groups: {groups}
admin.catalogLead: Only approved products appear in search. Hidden products are removed from search.
admin.noCatalogText: Approved requests will show up here.
admin.affEnvNote: Configured via COUPANG_ACCESS_KEY / COUPANG_SECRET_KEY / AMAZON_US_ASSOCIATE_TAG environment variables. Never stored in code.

catalog.title: Products
catalog.sourceNote: Based on the official global store
catalog.sourceInfo: Ingredient lists and directions are copied verbatim from each brand’s official global store. Products sold in Korea (e.g. Olive Young) may differ in formula or size, so compare with your own label. Sales rankings are not shown because no verified source is available.
catalog.addedVanity: Added to your vanity. Please check it against your label.
catalog.noMatchText: Send a product request for anything not listed yet.
catalog.orderInfo: The general texture-based order and the manufacturer’s directions are shown separately. When they differ, the manufacturer’s directions win.
catalog.noOfficialOrder: The manufacturer gives no specific order.
catalog.officialCombo: Ingredients the manufacturer says not to combine with

tex.waterFirst: Water is the first ingredient (water-based tendency).
tex.notWaterFirst: Water is not the first ingredient.
tex.note: Estimated from ingredient order. Actual amounts and feel are unknown.

catalog.molecularInfo: Molecular weight and lipophilicity come from PubChem (US NIH) single-compound data. Polymers, extracts and mixtures are marked as insufficient data.
catalog.molecularNote: Molecular weight alone is not used to judge absorption or application order; formula, concentration, solubility, skin barrier and delivery systems matter. Oil/water tendency is an XLogP-based estimate.

routines.title: My routines
routines.name: Routine name
routines.lead: Build a routine from products you pick and get an analysis of order, pros and cons.
routines.storageInfo: Your routines and notes are stored separately from the product database. Sign in under Settings → Sync across devices to keep them the same on PC and phone; otherwise they stay on this device.
routines.emptyText: Tap “Add to routine” on a product, or create a new routine.
routines.deleteText: The routine and its notes will be deleted from this device.

ra.title: Routine analysis
ra.info: Rule-based analysis by the app. Manufacturer directions, ingredient-list findings and general order rules are labelled separately. Not medical advice.
ra.empty: Add products to see an analysis.
ra.applied: Order updated (previous order saved as a version)
ra.patch: If your skin is sensitive, try new products on a small area first (patch test).
ra.conflict: The manufacturer says to use “{first}” before “{second}”.
ra.freq: {name}: start at about {n}× a week, per the manufacturer.

verdict.keepLong: This routine looks fine to keep as is: the order matches texture and official directions, and no flagged combinations were found.
verdict.adjustLong: Please check the items below. Each one names the product and the property behind it.

reason.texture: Thinner textures first within a step: {texture}

pro.hydrateSeal: A hydrating product (“{a}”) is sealed with a moisturizer (“{b}”). Results are not guaranteed.
pro.barrier: Ceramides found in the ingredient list: {names}
pro.oneActive: Only one product with potentially irritating actives (“{name}”), so little overlap.
pro.orderOk: The order matches texture and official directions.

con.duplicate: “{a}” and “{b}” are the same type with overlapping key ingredients. Check whether you need both.
con.activesStack: Several products contain potentially irritating actives: {names}. Overlapping them at the same time may increase irritation.
con.tooMany: {n} steps is on the long side. See if similar products can be dropped.
con.order: Differs from the suggested order based on texture and official directions.
con.slotPm: The manufacturer says to use “{name}” in the evening.
con.noSunscreen: Potentially irritating actives without morning sunscreen. Many manufacturers advise daytime sun protection.
con.pregnancy: You indicated pregnancy or breastfeeding. Consult a professional before using “{name}”.

note.ph: Contains pH-sensitive ingredients such as acids (AHA/BHA) or vitamin C. Products often direct using them early, right after cleansing (general info).
note.molecular: Molecular weight is shown for reference only and is not used to decide order.

sync.title: Sync across devices
sync.info: Sign in with the same email to keep your vanity, routines, notes and masks the same on PC and phone. Your skin profile (pregnancy etc.) and language stay on this device only.
sync.lead: Open the login link we email you in this browser. No password needed.
sync.linkSent: Email sent. Open the link in this browser.
sync.signedOut: Signed out. Data on this device stays.
sync.askTitle: You have data in the cloud
sync.askText: This account has a vanity and routines saved from another device. Which data should be used? The other side will be overwritten.

error.server_error: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
error.missing_fields: Please fill in the required fields.
error.invalid_image: Couldn't read the image. Use a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo.
error.ocr_auth_failed: Photo recognition service authentication failed. Contact the admin.
error.ocr_failed: Couldn't read the label. Retake it brighter and sharper, or enter it manually.
error.ocr_unreadable: The label text couldn't be read.
error.ocr_load_failed: Couldn't load the text recognition tool. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_state: That action isn't available right now.

community.lead: See which products others use, and in what order.
community.privacy: Sharing shows only your nickname, the skin type tag you pick, the routine name, product names and order, and a one-line note. Your email, skin profile, amounts, memos and logs stay private.
community.emptyText: Be the first to share one from the routine editor.
community.reportText: Report anything inappropriate. A routine is hidden automatically after 3 reports.
community.loginToReport: Sign in under Settings to report.
community.loginToShare: Sign in under Settings → Sync across devices to share routines.
community.notePlaceholder: e.g. This order feels best on dry days
community.unpublishText: It disappears from Explore. Your routine stays.
